page.title: Security & privacy
page.subtitle: Protect your account and manage your camp’s information

language.title: Language
language.blurb: The language CampCommand uses with you. Work orders other people write are translated into it for you too.

password.title: Password
password.changeBlurb: Change the password you use to sign in.
password.setBlurb: You sign in with an emailed code. Set a password to sign in with one instead — the emailed code keeps working either way.
password.tooShort: Password must be at least {{min}} characters.
password.same: That’s already your password. Choose a different one.

mfa.title: Two-step sign-in
mfa.blurb: Add a second step when you sign in, using a free authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy). Recommended for anyone with access to camper information.
mfa.scan: Scan this with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.cantScan: Can’t scan? Enter this key instead
mfa.startFailed: Could not start setup. Please try again.
mfa.codeMismatch: That code didn’t match. Check your authenticator app and try again.
mfa.confirmOff: Turn off two-step sign-in for this device? You’ll no longer be asked for a code from it when you sign in.

export.title: Download your data
export.blurb: Get a complete copy of everything in your camp as a single file, useful for your own records or backups. The download is noted in your activity log.
export.failed: The export didn’t finish. Please try again.

audit.title: Activity log
audit.blurb: A record of sensitive actions: who viewed or changed camper health info, team roles, retreat billing, data downloads and guest-link resets.

privacy.title: Privacy & security
privacy.blurb: Your camp’s information (including camper health details) is kept private to your camp and protected with industry-standard safeguards. The full details are here:
privacy.policyDesc: What we collect and how it’s used
